verses.text: Wisdom don build im house. E don carve im seven pillars.
E don kill im animals. E don mix im wine. E don also set im table.
E don send out im servant girls. E dey call from di highest places for di city:
“Anyone wey dey simple, make e turn in here.” As for am wey lack sense, e talk to am say,
“Come, eat my bread, and drink di wine wey I don mix.
Leave simple ways, and live. Waka for di way of understanding.”
Di one wey correct scoffer dey get shame for imself, and di one wey rebuke wicked man dey get insult.
No rebuke scoffer, or e go hate you. Rebuke wise man, and e go love you.
Give instruction to wise man, and e go still dey wiser. Teach righteous man, and e go increase for learning.
Di fear of di Lord na di beginning of wisdom. Knowledge of di Holy One na understanding.
Because by me your days go multiply, and years go dey added to your life.
If you dey wise, you dey wise for yourself. If you scoff, you alone go bear am.
Folly na loud woman, simple and no know anything.
E sit for di door of im house, on seat for di high places of di city,
to call to dem wey dey pass by, wey dey go straight for dem way:
“Anyone wey dey simple, make e turn in here.” As for am wey lack sense, e talk to am say,
“Stolen water dey sweet, and bread wey dem eat for secret dey pleasant.”
But e no know say di dead dey dere, say im guests dey for di depths of Sheol.
Di proverbs of Solomon. Wise pikin dey make papa glad, but foolish pikin na grief to im mama.
Treasures of wickedness no profit, but righteousness dey deliver from death.
Di Lord no go allow di righteous soul to hunger, but e dey push away di desire of di wicked.
Lazy hand dey make poverty, but di hand of di diligent dey bring riches.
Di one wey gather for summer na wise pikin, but di one wey sleep for harvest na pikin wey dey shame.
Blessings dey on di head of di righteous, but violence dey cover di mouth of di wicked.
Di memory of di righteous na blessing, but di name of di wicked go rot.
Di wise of heart go receive commandments, but di foolish talker go fall.
Whoever waka for integrity dey waka secure, but whoever make im ways crooked go dey found out.
Whoever wink im eye dey cause sorrow, and di foolish talker go fall.
Di mouth of di righteous na fountain of life, but violence dey cover di mouth of di wicked.
Hatred dey stir up strife, but love dey cover all wrongs.
Wisdom dey found for di lips of di one wey get understanding, but rod dey for di back of am wey lack sense.
Wise men dey store up knowledge, but di mouth of di foolish dey near ruin.
Di rich man wealth na im strong city. Di ruin of di poor na dem poverty.
Di wages of di righteous lead to life. Di profit of di wicked lead to sin.
Whoever heed instruction dey on di path of life, but whoever ignore reproof go astray.
Whoever hide hatred get lying lips, and whoever spread slander na fool.
For plenty words, sin no dey lack, but whoever restrain im lips dey wise.
Di tongue of di righteous na choice silver. Di heart of di wicked no worth much.
Di lips of di righteous dey feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
Di blessing of di Lord dey make rich, and e dey add no sorrow with am.
To do wickedness dey like sport to fool, but wisdom na pleasure to man wey get understanding.
Wetin di wicked dey fear go come on am, but di desire of di righteous go dey granted.
When di storm pass, di wicked no dey again, but di righteous dey stand firm forever.
As vinegar to di teeth and smoke to di eyes, so na lazy person to dem wey send am.
Di fear of di Lord dey prolong days, but di years of di wicked go dey cut short.
Di hope of di righteous na gladness, but di expectation of di wicked go perish.
Di way of di Lord na stronghold to di upright, but destruction to di workers of iniquity.
Di righteous no go ever dey moved, but di wicked no go dwell for di land.
Di mouth of di righteous dey produce wisdom, but di perverse tongue go dey cut off.
Di lips of di righteous know wetin dey acceptable, but di mouth of di wicked na perverseness.
Dishonest scales na abomination to di Lord, but accurate weight na im delight.
When pride come, den shame come, but wisdom dey with di humble.
Di integrity of di upright dey guide dem, but di crookedness of di treacherous go destroy dem.
Riches no profit for di day of wrath, but righteousness dey deliver from death.
Di righteousness of di blameless go make im way straight, but di wicked go fall by im own wickedness.
Di righteousness of di upright go deliver dem, but di unfaithful go dey caught by dem own greed.
When wicked man die, im hope perish, and di hope of riches perish too.
Di righteous dey delivered out of trouble, and di wicked take im place.
With im mouth di godless dey destroy im neighbor, but di righteous go dey delivered through knowledge.
When di righteous prosper, di city rejoice, and when di wicked perish, e get shouts of joy.
By di blessing of di upright, di city dey exalted, but by di mouth of di wicked, e dey overthrown.
Whoever despise im neighbor lack sense, but man of understanding dey keep quiet.
Whoever go about as slanderer dey reveal secrets, but whoever dey faithful for spirit dey keep di matter hidden.
Where no wise guidance dey, di people fall, but for plenty counselors dey safety.
Whoever guarantee for stranger go suffer for am, but whoever hate to shake hands for guarantee dey secure.
Gracious woman dey gain honor, and ruthless men dey gain riches.
Di merciful man dey do good to im own soul, but di cruel man dey trouble im own flesh.
Di wicked dey earn deceptive wages, but di one wey sow righteousness get sure reward.
Di one wey dey steadfast for righteousness go get life. Di one wey chase evil go get im own death.
Di perverse of heart na abomination to di Lord, but di blameless for dem way na im delight.
Know dis for sure: di wicked no go go unpunished, but di offspring of di righteous go dey delivered.
As gold ring for pig snout, so na beautiful woman wey lack discretion.
Di desire of di righteous na only good, but di expectation of di wicked na wrath.
Another dey give freely and still dey increase, and another dey hold back wetin e suppose give, and only come to want.
Di generous soul go prosper, and whoever refresh others go dey refreshed.
People go curse am wey hold back grain, but blessing dey on di head of am wey sell am.
Whoever diligently seek good dey seek favor, but evil go come to whoever search for am.
Whoever trust for im riches go fall, but di righteous go flourish like green leaf.
Whoever trouble im own house go inherit di wind, and di fool go be servant to di wise of heart.
Di fruit of di righteous na tree of life, and whoever win souls dey wise.
Look, di righteous go dey repaid for di earth. How much more di wicked and di sinner!
Whoever love instruction love knowledge, but whoever hate reproof na stupid.
Good man dey obtain favor from di Lord, but di Lord go condemn man wey plan wickedness.
Man no go dey established by wickedness, but di root of di righteous no go dey moved.
Worthy wife na crown to di husband, but wife wey dey cause shame dey like rottenness for im bones.
Di thoughts of di righteous dey just. Di advice of di wicked na deceit.
Di words of di wicked na ambush for blood, but di mouth of di upright go deliver dem.
Di wicked dey overthrown and dem no dey again, but di house of di righteous go stand.
Man dey praised according to im wisdom, but di one wey get twisted mind go dey despised.
E better to dey lowly and get servant than to dey honored and lack bread.
Righteous man dey regard di life of im animal, but di tender mercies of di wicked na cruel.
Whoever till im land go get plenty bread, but whoever follow worthless things lack sense.
Di wicked desire di loot of evil men, but di root of di righteous dey yield fruit.
Di evil man dey caught by di transgression of im lips, but di righteous go escape from trouble.
Man go dey satisfied with good by di fruit of im mouth, and di work of man hands go return to am.
Di way of fool dey right for im own eyes, but di wise man dey listen to counsel.
Fool dey show im annoyance right away, but di prudent dey hide shame.
Whoever speak truth dey declare righteousness, but false witness dey speak deceit.
Some person dey speak rashly like sword thrusts, but di tongue of di wise dey bring healing.
Truthful lips go last forever, but lying tongue na only for moment.
Deceit dey inside di heart of dem wey plan evil, but joy dey for dem wey counsel peace.
No harm dey happen to di righteous, but di wicked dey full of trouble.
Lying lips na abomination to di Lord, but dem wey deal truly na im delight.
Prudent man dey conceal knowledge, but di heart of fools dey proclaim foolishness.
Di hand of di diligent go rule, but di lazy go dey for forced labor.
Anxiety for man heart dey weigh am down, but good word dey make am glad.
Righteous man dey choose im friends carefully, but di way of di wicked dey lead dem astray.
Di lazy man no dey roast im game, but di precious wealth of man na to be diligent.
For di path of righteousness dey life, and for im pathway no death dey.
Wise pikin dey hear im papa instruction, but scoffer no dey listen to rebuke.
Man go eat good from di fruit of im mouth, but di desire of di treacherous na violence.
Whoever guard im mouth dey preserve im life, but whoever open wide im lips go come to ruin.
Di soul of di lazy dey desire and get nothing, but di soul of di diligent go dey richly supplied.
Di righteous hate lying, but di wicked dey bring shame and disgrace.
Righteousness dey guard di one wey dey blameless for way, but wickedness dey overthrow di sinner.
One dey pretend to dey rich, yet e get nothing. Another dey pretend to dey poor, yet e get great wealth.
Di ransom of man life na im riches, but di poor no dey hear threats.
Di light of di righteous dey shine brightly, but di lamp of di wicked go dey put out.
By pride na only quarrels dey come, but wisdom dey with dem wey take advice.
Wealth wey dem gain by vanity go dwindle, but whoever gather small by small go increase am.
Hope wey dem delay dey make di heart sick, but desire wey dem fulfill na tree of life.
Whoever despise instruction go pay for am, but whoever respect commandment go dey rewarded.
Di teaching of di wise na fountain of life, to turn person away from di snares of death.
Good understanding dey win favor, but di way of di unfaithful dey hard.
Every prudent man dey act with knowledge, but fool dey display im folly.
Wicked messenger dey fall into trouble, but faithful envoy dey bring healing.
Poverty and shame dey come to am wey refuse discipline, but whoever heed reproof go dey honored.
Desire wey dem fulfill dey sweet to di soul, but e dey abomination to fools to turn from evil.
Whoever waka with wise men go dey wise, but di companion of fools go suffer harm.
Misfortune dey chase sinners, but di righteous go dey rewarded with good.
Good man dey leave inheritance to im pikin dem pikin, and di wealth of di sinner dey stored up for di righteous.
Di field of di poor fit yield plenty food, but e dey swept away by injustice.
Whoever spare im rod hate im pikin, but di one wey love am dey discipline am early.
Di righteous dey eat to satisfy im soul, but di belly of di wicked go lack.
Every wise woman dey build im house, but di foolish dey tear am down with im own hands.
Whoever waka for uprightness fear di Lord, but di one wey dey perverse for im ways dey despise am.
For di mouth of di foolish na rod of pride, but di lips of di wise go preserve dem.
Where no ox dey, di manger clean, but plenty increase dey come by di strength of di ox.
Faithful witness no go lie, but false witness dey breathe out lies.
Scoffer dey seek wisdom and no find am, but knowledge dey easy to di one wey get understanding.
Go from di presence of fool, because you no go find knowledge for im lips.
Di wisdom of di prudent na to understand im way, but di folly of fools na deceit.
Fools dey mock at sin, but among di upright dey goodwill.
Di heart know im own bitterness, and stranger no fit share im joy.
Di house of di wicked go dey overthrown, but di tent of di upright go flourish.
Way dey wey seem right to man, but im end na di way of death.
Even for laughter di heart fit dey sorrowful, and di end of joy fit be grief.
Di backslider for heart go dey filled with im own ways, and good man go dey satisfied from im own.
Di simple believe every word, but di prudent dey consider im steps.
Wise man dey fear and turn away from evil, but di fool dey rage and dey overconfident.
Man wey quick to anger dey act foolishly, and man wey plan evil dey hated.
Di simple inherit folly, but di prudent dey crowned with knowledge.
Di evil bow down before di good, and di wicked at di gates of di righteous.
Di poor dey hated even by im neighbor, but di rich get many friends.
Whoever despise im neighbor dey sin, but blessed na am wey dey kind to di poor.
Dem wey plan evil no dey go astray? But faithful love and truth dey for dem wey plan good.
For all hard work dey profit, but mere talk dey lead only to poverty.
Di crown of di wise na dem riches, but di folly of fools na only folly.
Truthful witness dey save lives, but false witness dey speak lies.
For di fear of di Lord dey strong confidence, and im pikin dem go get refuge.
Di fear of di Lord na fountain of life, to turn person away from di snares of death.
For di multitude of people na di king glory, but for lack of people na di ruin of di prince.
Whoever slow to anger get great understanding, but whoever dey hot for temper dey exalt folly.
Heart wey dey at peace na life to di body, but envy na rottenness to di bones.
Whoever oppress di poor dey insult im Maker, but whoever dey kind to di needy dey honor am.
Di wicked dey brought down by im wrongdoing, but di righteous get refuge even for im death.
Wisdom dey rest for di heart of di one wey get understanding, but for di inward part of fools e dey make am known.
Righteousness dey exalt nation, but sin na disgrace to any people.
Di king favor dey toward servant wey act wisely, but im wrath dey toward am wey cause shame.
Soft answer dey turn away wrath, but harsh word dey stir up anger.
Di tongue of di wise dey use knowledge well, but di mouth of fools dey pour out folly.
Di eyes of di Lord dey every place, dey watch di evil and di good.
Gentle tongue na tree of life, but perverseness inside am dey break di spirit.
Fool dey despise im papa instruction, but whoever heed reproof dey prudent.
For di house of di righteous dey plenty treasure, but trouble dey di income of di wicked.
Di lips of di wise dey spread knowledge, but di heart of fools no dey so.
Di sacrifice of di wicked na abomination to di Lord, but di prayer of di upright na im delight.
Di way of di wicked na abomination to di Lord, but e love di one wey chase righteousness.
Severe discipline dey for am wey leave di path. Whoever hate reproof go die.
Sheol and Abaddon dey open before di Lord, how much more di hearts of di pikin dem of men!
Scoffer no love to dey reproved. E no go go to di wise.
Glad heart dey make cheerful face, but by sorrow of heart di spirit dey broken.
Di heart of di one wey get understanding dey seek knowledge, but di mouth of fools dey feed on folly.
All di days of di afflicted dey bad, but cheerful heart na continual feast.
E better to get small with di fear of di Lord than great treasure with trouble.
E better to get dinner of vegetables where love dey than fattened ox with hatred.
Hot tempered man dey stir up strife, but man wey slow to anger dey calm quarrel.
Di way of di lazy na like thorn hedge, but di path of di upright dey like highway.
Wise pikin dey make papa glad, but foolish man dey despise im mama.
Folly na joy to am wey lack sense, but man of understanding dey waka straight.
Plans dey fail where no counsel dey, but for plenty counselors dem dey succeed.
Man dey get joy from di reply of im mouth, and word wey dem speak for di right time, how good e be!
Di path of life go upward for di wise, to turn am away from Sheol below.
Di Lord go tear down di house of di proud, but e go establish di border of di widow.
Di thoughts of di wicked na abomination to di Lord, but di words of di pure dey pleasant.
Whoever dey greedy for unjust gain dey trouble im own house, but whoever hate bribes go live.
Di heart of di righteous dey think how to answer, but di mouth of di wicked dey pour out evil things.
Di Lord dey far from di wicked, but e dey hear di prayer of di righteous.
Di light of di eyes dey rejoice di heart. Good news dey make di bones healthy.
Di ear wey listen to life giving reproof go dwell among di wise.
Whoever refuse instruction dey despise im own soul, but whoever listen to reproof dey gain understanding.
Di fear of di Lord na instruction of wisdom, and humility dey come before honor.
Di plans of di heart belong to man, but di answer of di tongue dey from di Lord.
All di ways of man dey pure for im own eyes, but di Lord dey weigh di spirits.
Commit your work to di Lord, and your plans go dey established.
Di Lord don make everything for im own purpose, yes, even di wicked for di day of evil.
Everyone wey get proud heart na abomination to di Lord. Be sure of dis, e no go go unpunished.
By faithful love and truth, iniquity dey atoned for, and by di fear of di Lord, men dey turn away from evil.
When di ways of man dey please di Lord, e make even im enemies dey at peace with am.
E better to get small with righteousness than great income with injustice.
Man heart dey plan im way, but di Lord dey direct im steps.
Divine decision dey for di lips of di king. Im mouth no go betray justice.
Honest balance and scales belong to di Lord. All di weights for di bag na im work.
E na abomination to kings to do wrong, because di throne dey established by righteousness.
Righteous lips na delight to kings, and dem love am wey speak right.
Di wrath of di king na messenger of death, but wise man go appease am.
For di light of di face of di king dey life, and im favor dey like cloud of spring rain.
How much better to get wisdom pass gold! To get understanding dey more to dey chosen pass silver.
Di highway of di upright na to turn away from evil. Whoever guard im way dey preserve im soul.
Pride dey go before destruction, and haughty spirit before fall.
E better to dey humble for spirit with di lowly than to share plunder with di proud.
Whoever heed di word go find good, and blessed na am wey trust di Lord.
Di wise of heart go dey called prudent, and sweetness of lips dey increase learning.
Understanding na fountain of life to di one wey get am, but di instruction of fools na folly.
Di heart of di wise dey make im mouth wise and dey add learning to im lips.
Pleasant words na honeycomb, sweet to di soul and health to di bones.
Way dey wey seem right to man, but im end na di way of death.
Di appetite of di worker dey work for am, because im mouth dey urge am on.
Worthless man dey dig up evil, and im speech dey like scorching fire.
Perverse man dey stir up strife, and slanderer dey separate close friends.
Violent man dey entice im neighbor and lead am for way wey no good.
Whoever shut im eyes to plan perverse things, whoever purse im lips, dey bring evil to pass.
Gray hair na crown of glory. Dem dey find am for di way of righteousness.
Whoever slow to anger better pass di mighty, and whoever rule im spirit pass di one wey capture city.
Dem dey cast lot for di lap, but every decision of am dey from di Lord.
